changelog: Re-anchored low-end calibration: reserve 0–9 for only unmistakable fragments and prefer 20–29 for weak nonstandalone tails (trace: calibration_fix).

Tightened Top-band awarding: require both an independently renderable right and that nothing later can plausibly reassign or negate the left; withhold 85+ when surface cues mimic clause boundaries (trace: summary and cases).

Added concise guidance listing the four risky surface patterns observed in the critique (short trailing adjuncts ending in directional noun; immediate subordinators on the right; title + single capitalized token apposition; right-side restricting adverb immediately followed by prep/number). In presence of any, prefer Middle/Low instead of Top (trace: cases en_us_357, en_us_1105, en_us_1575).
Made scoring language more compact and deterministic: prefer conservative labels when in doubt between extreme-low and low (trace: calibration table), and round to integers.
Re-anchored example low scores upward to reflect the raised 20–29 anchor (keeps same examples but updates low-band numbers).
